event: Shut down from midday on 31 October 2022. To be converted to 150 MW of solar 70 MW of wind and 150 MW of batteries; no gas plant
source: Capacity: Eskom fact sheet GX 0001 Rev 29. Shutdown: Eskom coal-fired power stations page and statement of 31 October 2022
note: Only one unit of 121 MW was still running at shutdown. Eskom's July 2024 fact sheet still lists the station

event: Scheduled to shut down by 31 March 2030. Eskom: the older stations continue operating until FY2030. System operator: all five run to the end of 2028 and shut in phases from 2029 (5.26 GW in 2029 and 3.14 GW by March 2030). Eskom's decision between shutdown, repowering and repurposing, due end September 2026, had not been announced by 8 October 2026
source: Capacity: Eskom fact sheet GX 0001 Rev 29. Dates: Eskom Integrated Report 2025 pp.32 and 44; system operator Medium-Term System Adequacy Outlook 2026-2030 pp.16-18
